description: This Perl script generates C source code for testing curl options based on the included curl header definitions. It reads structured definitions from stdin, processes them (including preprocessor directives and multiline options), and outputs a generated C file with functions, macros, and test code related to curl configuration and info options.

methods.name: writecb
methods.description: A dummy write callback function for libcurl that matches the expected signature. It ignores the data and returns 0.

methods.name: readcb
methods.description: A dummy read callback function for libcurl that matches the expected signature. It ignores the buffer and returns 0.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Function to print an error message for a curl option with its name, value, and line number.

methods.name: geterr
methods.description: Function to print an error message for curl info with its name, value, and line number.
